category: image and video generation API, purchased credit only

free_tier.stated: none for the API: API access is separate from free or web app subscriptions and needs purchased API credits before a key can be created. The Free web-app plan gives 150 Fast Tokens a day, which reset daily, and does not include API calls. API credit is pay as you go, does not expire, and allows up to 10 concurrent generations.
free_tier.notes: third-party pages report a USD 5 starter credit on a new API account; no vendor page read states it, so it is unverified

retention.stated: images generated through the API do not expire and stay accessible from the web app

interface_detail: REST at https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1 with a bearer API key; optional webhook callback set when the key is created
tooling: raw HTTP with an API key created on the API Access page of the web app; the web app can export a generation as ready-to-use API code
chaining: the Free web-app plan is a daily allowance for the browser, usable for hand-made images, and the API is a separate paid lane; a batch pipeline needs bought API credit first. A free image allowance with an API is not available here.

limits.value: API access is separate from free or web app subscriptions: purchased API credits are needed before any key is created
Free web-app plan: 150 Fast Tokens a day, reset daily, no accumulation; not usable through the API

binding_note: an API key needs purchased credit, so the 150 daily Fast Tokens of the Free web plan never reach the API

identity_cost.detail: a free Leonardo account (email signup form not read), then a purchase of API credit ('Buy Credit') before 'Create New Key'; unverified: which payment methods are accepted and the minimum purchase

reliability_note: web-app tokens and API credit are separate balances billed separately
confidence_note: the separation of the API from the Free plan, the credit purchase before a key, the 10 concurrent generations and the 150 daily Fast Tokens are quoted from vendor pages; a starter credit on a new API account is unverified.
